title: Federal Rule 4 — summons and service
summary: Service of process is the formal delivery or legally authorized communication of the summons and complaint or equivalent initiating papers. It tells a defendant that a judicial proceeding requires a response.

sections.Role in the course: Service of process is the formal delivery or legally authorized communication of the summons and complaint or equivalent initiating papers. It tells a defendant that a judicial proceeding requires a response.
sections.What to examine: Identify the court system, type of defendant, location of service, person who served, method used, and applicable rule. Then separately evaluate constitutional notice and whether service establishes the needed territorial reach.
